name: manual_0dfe5b
claim: When a peer stalls with a claimed queue task, verify the actual claimant and independently check claimed completion evidence. Only that live claimant may run queue fail <task_id> <claimant_id> --notes <reason>; it requeues only when retry_count is below max_retries, and queue claim cannot take an already claimed task. Never impersonate an absent claimant. Before global heartbeat cleanup, confirm all agents classified DEAD and obtain authorization for every affected legacy and queue claim; cleanup can requeue exhausted tasks, so hold unsafe or exhausted claims for separately reviewed authorized recovery. A reserved handoff retains required_agent_id and needs reservation-aware authorized recovery before transfer.

decisions.notes: Code-reviewed correction preserving the prior lesson while retiring unsafe absent-claimant and missing-claimant command guidance.

rationale: Code-reviewed correction preserving the prior lesson while retiring unsafe absent-claimant and missing-claimant command guidance.
